title: Dreamworlds (Cross-post)
content: Mine are places "just a little further down the road" - meaning that the dream starts in a familiar place. Then, I travel just a little beyond it (which should also be familiar) and discover entirely new features, such as water parks, towns, etc that don't exist in this world. Plus, they are recurring dreams. When the dream starts, I'm not sure if I'm in real life or in that alternate dream world. However, once I figure it out, I know how to get around in the dream world. I revisit places I've been before. For example, there is a historical building that gives tours. Used to be, I'd lag behind the tour group for a closer look at a desk where I had discovered a drawer. In the drawer was a piece of paper with doodles. I would take it out and put it back, enjoying my little secret. Then, one dream - one visit, the paper was no longer there. There's a small university library where they seem to know me and I'm allowed free reign. Their book fairs are incredible - with the whole community participating. There's a lake surrounded by a steep banked hill. People go there to put down a blanket an sun themselves. All this happens in a dream land area that, in the real world, is a completely overgrown woodland with abandoned coal mines underneath. I've had the mall / ultra futuristic hybrid experience, too. I call it the "Logan's Run" universe because everything is seems as if it is under one roof - like the malls in the 80s. Apartments, restaurants, entertainment, clinics, zoos... everything. It's so clean and streamlined.
